domain.types: simple undirected graph with positive integer edge weights
domain.relationships: vertices numbered 1 through N; no self-loops or repeated unordered edges

input.format: N M S T on the first line, then M lines of u v w; each edge connects u and v in both directions with cost w

state.mutable: current vertex and sum of traversed edge weights

actions.preconditions: an undirected edge connects the current vertex and the next vertex
actions.transition: move to the adjacent vertex and add the edge weight w to the distance
actions.reuse: vertices and edges may be revisited; each traversal pays its edge weight

goal.definition: sum of edge weights in a walk from S to T

termination: reach T; output -1 if no path exists

output.ties: print the minimum distance only, not a path
output.empty: S equals T: output 0, even when there are no edges
output.impossible: output -1 when T is unreachable from S

limits.executionConstraints: 1 <= S,T,u,v <= N; u != v; unordered edge pairs are unique; 1 <= w <= 1000000000

obligations.smallDomain: N <= 4; compare all-pairs shortest paths independently
boundaryCases: minimum cost path has more edges than the direct path
obligations.stress: N=100 chain and N=100 M=200 graph
mutants: vertex distance finalized on first discovery
